aboutMissionVision.headline: Our Purpose, Built on Two Pillars.
aboutMissionVision.missionText: To develop urban renovation projects of excellence that transform urban properties into intelligent, functional, and contemporary spaces, while offering medium-term housing solutions that combine comfort, quality of life, and sustainable value for residents.
aboutMissionVision.visionText: To be a reference in urban rehabilitation and in the real estate sector in general, recognized for the ability to create properties of value, which balance design, functionality, and ethics, and for offering a service of excellence, personalized and focused on the well-being and convenience of each resident.

aboutWhatWeDo.headline: Two ways we put our craft to work.
aboutWhatWeDo.activity1Text: We develop real estate urban renovation projects and operate them within the market through a mid-term rental strategy.
aboutWhatWeDo.activity1Cta: Explore our mid-rental properties in Porto
aboutWhatWeDo.activity2Text: We partner with investors to deliver tailored real estate projects, providing hands-on guidance from acquisition and concept design through to execution and monetisation.
aboutWhatWeDo.activity2Cta: Explore some of the projects we developed

aboutValues.headline: Four values that shape every project.
aboutValues.value1Desc: The fundamental pillar of our expertise. We aim to maximize the potential of every property, transforming spaces into functional and comfortable environments tailored to our residents' daily lives.
aboutValues.value2Desc: We prioritize clear and insightful communication regarding our properties, fostering transparent and long-lasting bonds with our residents and partners.
aboutValues.value3Desc: We are guided by solid ethical principles and a deep sense of responsibility in how we rehabilitate, value, and manage each property, as well as how we welcome and support our residents.
aboutValues.value4Desc: We develop contemporary urban renovation projects equipped with updated technologies and systems. This ensures all our properties remain current and relevant for many years to come.

aboutTrajectory.headline: Mastering urban renovation since 2006.
aboutTrajectory.spainText: Our activity began in 2006, focused on developing urban renovation projects for the long-term rental market. We developed projects everywhere across the country, but mostly in beautiful cities like Barcelona and Girona.
aboutTrajectory.portoText: In 2017 we relocated our activity to Porto, where we have centralized all our operations to this day. All these years of activity were fundamental to define our identity and our philosophy: essentially how we operate.

aboutDistinction.headline: Specialists, by trajectory.
aboutDistinction.body: What sets us apart is our trajectory, positioning us as specialists in urban renovation with niche market expertise. We develop complex, reliable, and high-standard real estate projects across various sectors, through the application of rigorous and efficient procedures designed to deliver consistent results.

aboutFAQ.headline: Frequently asked questions.
aboutFAQ.intro_pre: A few things people often ask us. If your question is not here,
aboutFAQ.intro_post: directly and we will get back to you.
aboutFAQ.q1: What types of properties does BSMARTISH renovate?
aboutFAQ.a1: For our own portfolio, we focus on urban properties suited to mid-term rentals, typically apartments and small buildings. However, we also develop other projects with different profiles alongside our partner investors and property owners.
aboutFAQ.q2: What is a mid-term rent and who is it for?
aboutFAQ.a2: Midterm rentals cover stays from a minimum of 30 days up to twelve months. These are usually designed for relocating professionals, families in transition, digital nomads, or long term travelers seeking a fully furnished home ready to move into, with greater flexibility than a traditional long term lease.
aboutFAQ.q3: Can I commission a renovation project for my own property?
aboutFAQ.a3: Yes. We work with property owners who want to renovate their building to a high standard, whether to live in it, to rent it, or to sell it. We bring the same procedures and standards we apply to our own portfolio.
aboutFAQ.a4: Today our operations are centralized in Porto, where most of our active properties and ongoing projects are located.
aboutFAQ.q5: How long does a typical urban renovation project take?
aboutFAQ.a5: Timelines depend on the scope, the building, and any licensing involved. As a general reference, a full apartment renovation typically takes between four and nine months from project start to handover. We share a realistic schedule before any work begins.
aboutFAQ.q6: How can I get in touch about a property or a partnership?
